reviews.title: Cool, quiet, and easy installation.
reviews.comment: I haven't overclocked my processor yet, but it's a stock AMD Ryzen 9900x and this cooler keeps it cool! It is quiet also. It's relatively easy to install.
reviews.author: Zac

reviews.title: Great performance to price ratio
reviews.comment: So far so good, It looks great, I like it that the RGB is more subtle than overpowering like some other fans can be. Performing well with the thermal paste I'm using. Sitting at a cool 44C on a 9800X3D during light use. Thermalright does thermals right should be their slogan. Hopefully it lasts me awhile like my last CPU cooler did. Feels solidly built, pending on your rig though you might have to place the fan near the ram slightly higher than the other fan because the ram can get in the way, but I wont hold it against them, as far as I can tell its still performing very well. My first time buying a Thermalright product and I'm very pleased with its performance.
reviews.author: Nomad

reviews.title: Excellent Air Cooler for Ryzen 7800X3D
reviews.comment: This is one of the best performing and best looking matte Air Coolers for Ryzen 7800X3D with not so glaring RGB lighting. Under idle i get 41c at 996rpm, under load i was getting 77C at 2100rpm, but it the fan noise was audible, so i lowered the fan speed to 80% and getting 79c at 1758rpm, and noise was significantly reduced to something i am more comfortable with. The finish is matte black and looks great in my matte black case. I only have 2 intake fans in the case and 1 exhaust fan in the case. If I add 3 more exhaust fans on the top of the case, im sure thermals would be reduced even more, but i like the look of a clean case. This air cooler came packaged with everything necessary to mount on AM4, AM5, intel sockets, and with very good thermal paste.
reviews.author: Eddie-L

reviews.title: Really nice cooler
reviews.comment: I got this for my cousin's build with an R7 7800X3D. All that cache makes the CPU run hot, but this kept it under 85C when loaded with Cinebench. Really easy mounting system. I didn't even have to remove the backplate (which was nice, because I didn't even think about that until AFTER installing the motherboard). The AM4 cooler in my own build needed a custom backplate. My one complaint is the fan mounts. The wire clips are annoying, since they are not attached to the cooler (something I really like about my own). It's not much of a problem. Just a slight annoyance because I dropped them twice. The fans seemed to have a bit of a whine at higher speeds. Maybe that's just this one unit, but I am not sure. But MAN I was not prepared for how nice the LEDs on these fans look. Genuinely way better than fans that light up the blades. Overall, I really like it. Amazing for the price. I would buy one for my own build when I need a new cooler, unless Thermalright makes something prettier.
reviews.author: Defenestrator IV

reviews.title: Powerful, quiet, sleek
reviews.comment: Great air cooler. Easy to install if you know how to install one. (My first time, watched others do it) Basically a cheap noctua that performs just as well. Noise? Really quiet. Fans maxed out yeah you can hear it but even music at a low level will over power the fan and you won't even notice it. No compatibility issues, MSI z490.
reviews.author: tom mccormick
